module: Unit tests of mathlib (vec3, quat, scalar helpers, curves, geometry, StackVec3/push3), to be run with testFramework/TestManager. Also contains loop performance tests and "no garbage" tests that verify that in-place operations allocate no memory. Launch: `require('testFramework/TestManager'):runTestFiles('mathlib')` in the GE console. Useful to a modder as a catalog of usage examples of the mathlib functions.
notes: Each function takes a context `ctx` provided by TestManager and is not meant to be called directly.
Constant EPS = 1e-6 for float comparisons; assertVec3 compares x, y, z and assertFinite rejects NaN and ±inf.
The "Perf" tests do 10000 iterations; the "NoGarbage" tests impose an allocation budget (allowGarbage 0 to 1024 bytes, checkGarbage(0)).

testMathlibVec3Core.desc: Tests the vec3 constructors, basic arithmetic, normalization and the helpers.

testMathlibVec3Geom.desc: Tests the geometric methods of vec3: distances, barycentric coordinates, projection, orthonormal basis, mutators.

testMathlibVec3NoiseAndHelpers.desc: Tests the noise/random generators of vec3 and the axis and line helpers.

testMathlibPush3.desc: Tests StackVec3 (push3): parity with the basic vec3 operations.

testMathlibQuat.desc: Tests quaternion construction, algebra, interpolation and conversions.

testMathlibGeneric.desc: Tests the generic scalar helpers: sign, clamp, interpolation, medians, bounds.

testMathlibCurves.desc: Tests the curve interpolation helpers (spline families, Catmull-Rom, Bézier).

testMathlibGeom.desc: Tests the families of geometric overlap, containment and intersection helpers.

testMathlibSpecialValuesAndOddities.desc: Tests behavior on NaN, infinity and division by zero in the math helpers.

testPerfVec3Batch.desc: Benchmark: vec3 arithmetic (dot, length, cross, normalized, sum) over 10000 iterations.

testPerfScalarBatch.desc: Benchmark: scalar math helpers in a tight loop.

testPerfGeometryBatch.desc: Benchmark: representative geometric queries in a tight loop.

testNoGarbageScalarMathHelpers.desc: Verifies that the scalar helpers loop (sign, clamp, lerp, smoothstep, biasFun...) allocates nothing (budget 512 bytes, checkGarbage(0)).

testNoGarbageVec3InPlace.desc: Verifies that the in-place vec3 operations (setAdd2, setSub, setScaled, setComponentMul, setLerp, setCross) allocate nothing.

testNoGarbageQuatInPlace.desc: Verifies that the in-place quaternion operations (setMul2, setInvMul2, setMulInv2, normalize) allocate nothing.

testNoGarbageScalarSingleShot.desc: Verifies that clamp, lerp, inverseLerp and smoothstep called once allocate no memory (budget 0).
